title: Start: Trader spreadsheet templates?
detail: Google Sheets trade journal plus options risk and position-size calculator, sold for $12 on Gumroad (no monthly fee; about $9.65 kept per sale). Claude builds and maintains it; you create the account, connect payout and approve listings. Realistic first 90 days: $0 to $150 (low confidence). Your time: About 2 hours setup, then 30 min a week.
